0022600016.text: The Boston Celtics host the Chicago Bulls in their fifth game of the season and enter at 3-1, with a perfect 3-0 home record, a three-game winning streak, and a spot second in the Atlantic, half a game back, and fourth in the East. Chicago is 1-4 and has lost three straight, sitting fourth in the Central, three games back, and 12th in the East, and the Bulls are missing Nic Claxton (hamstring), Patrick Williams (groin soreness), and Tobe Awaka (ankle). Boston leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 134-99 win in Boston on October 26, and the Celtics won the 2025-26 series 2-1, while Devin Carter is out for Boston with an illness.
